title: Invertibility of the top restriction derived pullback unit
statement:
theorem standardSingleBaseChange_topRestriction_iso_pullback_unit
    [∀ X : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (s : X ≅ Z) :
    IsIso (relativeMVAdj s.hom).unit

proof.text: Use exists_derivedPullbackComposition to obtain the identity comparison i. Compose relativeMVComp with s.inv_hom_id and i Z, and with s.hom_inv_id and i X, to identify both composites of derivedPullback s.hom and derivedPullback s.inv with identity functors. Functor.Faithful.of_comp_iso gives faithfulness of both functors; Functor.Full.of_comp_faithful_iso gives fullness of derivedPullback s.hom. The unit of its adjunction relativeMVAdj s.hom is invertible because the left adjoint is fully faithful.
